name: Reaper::shutdown_all

test_list.description: Resources are torn down Task, Process, WorkerPipe, Sandbox, TempDir, IpcSegment; inside one kind the most recently registered goes first; the report lists them in exactly that order.
Each registered resource appears exactly once in the report with its id and kind.
A resource whose teardown returns an error is reported Failed with the error text; every other resource is still torn down.
A second shutdown_all returns AlreadyShutDown and tears nothing down again.
Registering a resource after shutdown started returns AlreadyShutDown.
A released resource is not torn down and release of an unknown id is UnknownResource.
The TeardownReason chosen in the config reaches each resource.

dependencies: polaris_kernel_reaper::{Reaper, ResourceKind, Teardown, ShutdownConfig, ShutdownReport, Outcome}

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Reason and the graceful, forced and overall deadlines.

output_description: A per-resource report in teardown order, or AlreadyShutDown on a repeated call.
